components.name: acme-support-bot
components.description: acme-support-bot is a Java Spring Boot backend that powers the customer support chat widget, generating chat replies and ticket summaries via OpenAI's cloud API. It's exposed through acme-frontend and handles a high volume of customer-facing traffic.

components.name: acme-analytics
components.description: acme-analytics is a scheduled batch service that generates business insights from internal data using Anthropic's cloud API. It runs as a background job rather than serving live user traffic.

components.name: acme-docsearch
components.description: acme-docsearch is a Java service that indexes and semantically searches internal documentation using a self-hosted Ollama model, keeping document content and embeddings entirely within the organization's own infrastructure.
